About Me
Data & Insights Analyst @ World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA)

I'm a data professional based in Switzerland, specialising in transforming complex data into actionable insights, robust products, and compelling visual stories. At the Swiss Federal Statistical Office, I sat at the intersection of engineering, analysis, and design — building the infrastructure that powers federal statistics, and crafting the visualizations that communicate them to the public.

My background gives me a strong quantitative foundation and a spatial perspective on data problems. Over the years, I've expanded into data engineering (Databricks, PySpark, ETL pipelines), BI products (semantic models, data catalogs, Streamlit apps), machine learning, and data community management — always with a focus on usability and impact.

🔗 LinkedIn ✉ Email 📊 Portfolio

  • Interface between business users and data architects — identifying data needs and translating them into technical requirements

  • Developing BI products: reports, semantic data models, schemas and data catalogs
  • Building interactive Streamlit applications for internal data access
  • Animating and growing the internal data community
  • Data analysis, machine learning and log / activity analysis
